title: Contradictory evidence — note says 'dry, historic', the reading says 60%
why: The typed note calls the staining historic and the ceiling dry. The recorded reading at the stain is 60% WME. The finding must not present 'dry' or 'historic' as fact; the verifier should find the contradiction; confidence must be low or the gate must hold it.

room.name: Living Room
room.note: Historic staining to ceiling by the window, dry now, old leak long since fixed.

transcripts: Living room ceiling by the window, brown staining, looks old. Reading at the stain sixty percent, hmm, that's high. Away from it nine.

must_not_happen.label: 'dry' or 'historic' never stated as fact against a 60% reading
the pipeline does not agree the leak is historic with a live 60% reading
a rectified historic leak is not the preferred cause

allowed_uncertainty: Active water ingress (live leak) as preferred at medium, or uncertain. Either way the surveyor must see the disagreement.
reviewer_notes: The surveyor noticed ('hmm, that's high') but typed the opposite. Real life.
